task.pr_title: Get RUN_AS_DEVIN working with app sandbox

cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description: This seems dangerous--IIUC it's going to change permissions _on the host_, because we mount it

evidence.attached_diff_hunk:
@@ -0,0 +1,21 @@
+#!/bin/bash
+# check user is root
+if [ "$(id -u)" -ne 0 ]; then
+  echo "Please run as root"
+  exit 1
+fi
+
+if [ -z "$SANDBOX_USER_ID" ]; then
+  echo "SANDBOX_USER_ID is not set"
+  exit 1
+fi
+
+# change uid of opendevin user to match the host user
+# but the group id is not changed, so the user can still access everything under /app
+usermod -u $SANDBOX_USER_ID opendevin
+
+# make docker.sock accessible to the user
+chmod 777 /var/run/docker.sock
evidence.thread_resolution: xingyaoww: fixed in the latest commit by changing the `opendevin` user's gid!
